READ Architecture Design, a boutique, design-driven architecture and interior design studio based in New York City and Miami, is seeking an Intermediate Architect / Architectural Designer to join our New York team.
About READ
We're a tight-knit studio that values strong design judgment, craft, direct collaboration, and taking ownership. Our work spans residential renovations, landmarked and historic properties, adaptive reuse, ground-up projects, rezoning and feasibility studies throughout New York City, with a growing number of commercial projects in both NYC and Miami.
About the Role
You will work closely with the Principal and project leads on residential, mixed-use, and landmarked projects throughout New York City. This role is focused on technical production, documentation, coordination, and supporting projects through design and construction.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys the technical side of architecture and is looking to deepen their experience in detailed project delivery, consultant coordination, and navigating NYC approvals.
Level: Intermediate Architect / Architectural Designer (3-6 years experience)
Reports to: Principal, Director
Responsibilities
Support projects through all phases, including Schematic Design (SD), Design Development (DD), Construction Documents (CD), and Construction Administration (CA)
Produce construction documents, architectural details, and drawing sets
Develop technical detailing for residential and commercial projects
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and regulatory agencies including DOB and LPC
Assist with permit submissions, agency approvals, and project administration
Participate in site visits, field verification, and construction coordination
Maintain drawing standards, file organization, and project documentation
Contribute to quality control and coordination across project deliverables
Qualifications
3-6 years of professional experience in an architecture office
Experience working on NYC residential (must), mixed-use and commercial projects
Familiarity with NYC DOB filing and permitting processes
Experience working with the Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) is strongly preferred
Strong technical and detailing skills with the ability to produce accurate construction documents
Professional experience using AutoCAD in an office environment, including file setup, drawing organization, xref management, and consultant coordination
Proficiency in Rhino, SketchUp, and Adobe Creative Suite
Strong organizational and communication skills
Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a small studio environment
Licensure or progress toward licensure is a plus, but not required
